notes.hook: Detonating one atomic bomb per second is an instantly arresting opening concept.
notes.clarity: The engineering logic flows smoothly from propulsion to shock absorption, though specific impulse is slightly technical.
notes.payoff: The discovery that a simple coat of oil protected against nuclear fireballs provides a brilliant, counterintuitive twist.
notes.visuals: Authentic archival blueprints, physical model photos, and atmospheric test imagery illustrate the concept effectively.
notes.loop: The cancellation provides a clean historical conclusion, though it lands as a natural stop rather than an unbroken sentence into the hook.

rounds.better_than_last: It delivers a much more shocking and memorable payoff than recent episodes through the bizarre revelation that cooking oil stopped nuclear fireballs.
